name: Evangeline
source:
Tarot: The Fool
Music Genre: Visual Kei, Breakcore, R&B
Likes: Games of all types, housework, older women
Dislikes: Working, being pressured to pursue academia, computers

Eva loves the small town lifestyle. She doesn't care
if people think she's heading nowhere fast. She believe she'll
always be able to fallback on family and friends in the end. Everyone
needs a handy butch around.

Doesn't really over analyze people and tries to go off of what she sees
with her eyes. Not very gifted academically, but she is the most
socially intelligent of the cast.

Many people in Eva's town are aware of her existence because 
she does so much random work. Some are concerned about 
her relationship with Adelaide due to the age difference, but 
Eva laughs and calls her a 'prey bunny princess.' 

[From in-game profile]
